optional_reach_hmm.status: not part of primary153; requires separately frozen mechanism
optional_reach_hmm.reason: native Push-T has one plan per episode, so online temporal HMM adaptation versus static routing is not identifiable there

independence: Use all11 official held Push source trajectories; alternate windows or arms do not create new independent sources.

pairing.baseline_goal_replay: Use cached raw goal stimulus for all arms; verify start physics and pixels; do not replace original goal if regeneration differs.
pairing.sham: Match each semantic edit's norm in the explicitly frozen native activation units at the same site/tokens/times; raw planner commands and applied simulator controls are distinct.

endpoints.pusht_primary: original env.eval_state(goal_state,final_state).success: position difference<20 and wrapped angle difference<pi/9
pusht_secondary: overlap with cached expert goal geometry, only after separately verified geometry reconstruction
endpoints.pusht_coverage_caution: Current info coverage is relative to rendered default painted goal; do not call it cached expert-goal overlap without checking goal alignment.

analysis.primary_contrast: static Sonar minus unsteered, separately by task
analysis.binary_summary: paired success-rate difference and discordant counts; exact paired test (McNemar/binomial on discordant pairs)
analysis.continuous_summary: paired per-start differences in prespecified native endpoint
analysis.uncertainty: episode/source-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals, all arms for a start resampled together; no frame-level pseudoreplication
analysis.sham_contrast: semantic minus matched sham is a prespecified specificity check

state_selection: full paired episodes begin at original starting conditions; missing later CEM warm-start capture does not block initial-state steering
